howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From unboxing to insight in four straightforward steps — no installation crew, no complex integration.

steps.title: Deploy the Sensor Kit
steps.description: Unbox and self-install the compact roadside unit in minutes. Power it with the included 230V adapter, a 12V battery, or a solar panel — no technician visit required.

steps.title: Collect Telemetry Data
steps.description: The device continuously and anonymously measures vehicle counts, speed distribution, and acoustic frequency spectrum, correlating it with live weather conditions.

steps.title: Return & Sync
steps.description: Ship the unit back using the prepaid return box, or sync remotely where connectivity allows. All data is encrypted and 100% anonymized — no video, no license plates.

steps.title: Get Your Report
steps.description: Receive an automated PDF & web analysis report with actionable insights — ready to support municipal decisions, traffic planning, and safety investments.

dataReports.title: Decision-Ready Insights, Automatically Generated
dataReports.subtitle: Every deployment produces a structured analysis report designed to support municipal and infrastructure decisions — no manual data crunching required.

about.title: Built for Trustworthy, Actionable Traffic Intelligence
paragraphs: Monitec designs diagnostic telemetry and decision-support systems that help municipalities, planners, and infrastructure teams understand how vehicles move through their roads — without compromising the privacy of the people behind the wheel.

Our compact, self-installable sensor kits are shipped directly to customers, powered by standard 230V, 12V battery, or solar setups, and return fully anonymized statistical reports — never video, never license plates, never audio recordings of conversations.
Founded by a former longtime Airbus engineer, Monitec applies aerospace-grade system documentation and engineering rigor to roadside telemetry and traffic analysis.

values.title: Privacy by Design
values.description: Every product decision starts with anonymization — we build systems that measure behavior, not identity.

values.title: Self-Install Simplicity
values.description: Hardware that ships in a box and works out of it — no technicians, no downtime, no complexity.

values.title: Decision-Ready Data
values.description: We don't just collect data — we transform it into reports municipalities and planners can act on immediately.

privacy.title: Compliance Built Into Every Layer
privacy.subtitle: Monitec is engineered from the ground up to respect the privacy of every individual on the road, while still delivering the insights decision-makers need.

guarantees.title: No Video or Image Storage
guarantees.description: Our sensors process signals in real time and never store video footage or still images of vehicles or people.

guarantees.title: No License Plate Recognition
guarantees.description: Vehicle identification is never performed — data is captured and reported purely as anonymized statistics.

guarantees.title: GDPR & CNIL Compliant
guarantees.description: Fully aligned with EU GDPR and French CNIL requirements, as well as Austrian DSGVO standards for municipal deployments.

guarantees.title: 100% Anonymized Statistics
guarantees.description: All outputs — counts, speed distributions, acoustic spectrums — are aggregate statistical data with no personal identifiers.
